tools.description: Launch a run. optimizer is Swarms (swarms_v2, the default) unless pinned; Fork-and-Flush (fork_flush) is opt-in and never the default.

continue_from.description: Seed a fresh run (own budget, limits, sandboxes and holds) from a terminal run in this organization. Refused before any run or hold with 404 continue_from_not_found (also for another organization's run), 409 continue_from_not_terminal or 409 continue_from_inputs_unavailable. An admitted continuation records RunLineage, shown on the result and the report; the parent is never resumed.

domicile_requirement.description: Frozen sandbox domicile. Omit for the environment default; production defaults to US only.

guidance.description: What the run must address. The planner covers or declines each item. A metric on an item binds every objective derived from it, and the planner cannot change or drop it. Not accepted with research profiles.

oneOf.description: A target the platform measures from scored rollouts.

target.description: A number, or a decimal string to keep digits a float cannot hold.

launch_menu_revision.description: getLaunchChoices menu_revision the choices were made against. A different current menu is refused 409 launch_menu_revision_stale with current_revision. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key and the same choices returns the accepted run; different choices are refused 422 idempotency_key_reused.

limits.description: An explicit positive USD budget is required. Task limits are service-owned; worker parallelism defaults to 1 and may be raised with parallel_workers. maximum_charge must fund every actor held at once (the planner and the workers, plus the reviewer with parallel workers), each holding at least one worst-case model call on its routed preset; a smaller maximum_charge is refused at launch with 422 run_budget_below_call_bound, cause limits.maximum_charge, whose Problem states the minimum budget as the integer minimum_budget_micros and its inputs in budget_floor (call bounds, compute holds, actor floor, actor count).

maximum_tokens.description: Deprecated. Recorded on the run for backwards compatibility, but Swarms does not enforce a hard token ceiling; bound spend with maximum_charge.

parallel_workers.description: The planner may run up to this many workers at once (one worker per task). The service default is 1. Out of range is refused at launch with 422 invalid_launch_request, cause limits.parallel_workers. The budget must fund the planner, the reviewer and every parallel worker at once (each parallel worker holds an equal slice of the budget, and never less than one worst-case model call); a smaller maximum_charge is refused at launch with 422 run_budget_below_call_bound, whose Problem states the minimum in micro-USD (minimum_budget_micros). Not accepted with research profiles.

pause_retention_seconds.description: Retention bound for each pause; expiry ends the run.

wall_time_seconds.description: Total unpaused seconds since creation, including queued time. Omitted, the profile default applies.

params.description: Public topology controls. Omitted fields keep the server's defaults (for swarms_v2, max_tasks is the larger of 4 and limits.parallel_workers and max_repairs_per_task is 2; for fork_flush, branches is 4, rounds is 3 and exploit_bps is 3000). Any field belonging to another topology is refused with optimizer_params_unsupported. Spend, time, token and concurrency limits stay authoritative.

branches.description: Exploratory branches forked per round, 2 to 32. Default 4. Only on a fork_flush pin.

exploit_bps.description: Per-round budget share reserved for incumbent refinement in basis points, 1000 to 6000. Default 3000. Only on a fork_flush pin.

max_repairs_per_task.description: Most repair attempts per task after a rejected review, 0 to 32. Default 2. Only on a swarms_v2 pin.

max_tasks.description: Most tasks the planner's work plan may hold, 1 to 4096. Default max(4, limits.parallel_workers); must be at least limits.parallel_workers. Only on a swarms_v2 pin.

rounds.description: Exploit-fork-flush rounds, 1 to 16. Default 3. Only on a fork_flush pin.

topology.description: swarms_v2 is Swarms, the default. fork_flush is Fork-and-Flush, opt-in and never the default.

profile.description: Published run profile ID from GET /v1/profiles. Omit for Core's default. No silent substitution of an explicit choice.

research_task.description: Required by research profiles; names this organization's approved published task. Refused for a general profile.

sandbox_option.description: An option id from the sandbox profile's options. Requires sandbox_profile.

role_assignments.description: Per declared actor (getLaunchChoices roles) inference and sandbox choices. Requires launch_menu_revision. An omitted actor or dimension takes its default; planner_decides leaves it for the planner. Unknown actors, choices outside the menu, excluded choices and choices policy refuses are refused before any hold. Not accepted with research profiles.

routing.description: Unordered hard restrictions across every managed inference actor. Provider restrictions include intermediaries and serving hosts. Omission leaves assignment to Synth.
